title: Application.
bodyText: This chapter shall be applicable to the acquisition of real property under the laws of the State for use in any project or program in which federal or federal-aid funds are used.
bodyHtml: [§113-1]  Application.  This chapter shall be applicable to the acquisition of real property under the laws of the State for use in any project or program in which federal or federal-aid funds are used. [L 1971, c 32, §1]
